title: cygnus 0.1.0: analysis toolkit build status
summary: Which parts of the Cygnus Python toolkit exist, which are scaffolds, and which are only designed, as recorded in the project's module register.
description_md: Cygnus is a Python package (`src/cygnus`, version 0.1.0). Its core is standard-library only; the science stack installs through optional extras (`mast`, `timing`, `imaging`, `moving`, `test`). The register below is read from the analysis-stack document at build time, so the site cannot claim more than the project records.
research_status: Scaffold · most detection modules not yet built
